added.title: Head of Engineering
added.description:
About Exoserva

Exoserva is building an AI-native operations platform for field-service businesses. The product brings customer communication, scheduling, dispatch, jobs, estimates, invoices, payments, mobile workflows, integrations, and AI-assisted operations into one system.

We test the product against real operating workflows rather than treating field service as an abstract software category. Our goal is straightforward: help service businesses run with clearer ownership, faster customer response, reliable execution, and less administrative friction.

Exoserva is a remote company. This posting is for candidates located in the United States. The role requires meaningful overlap with US business hours, including at least four working hours with Pacific Time on most weekdays.

Compensation

$190,000–$240,000 USD base salary per year. Final compensation will depend on relevant experience, role scope, employment structure, and location. Any additional compensation or benefits will be discussed transparently during the process.

The role

We are looking for a hands-on Head of Engineering to build the engineering organization around a substantial Node.js and TypeScript product. This is not a role for managing tickets from a distance. You will own architecture, engineering accountability, code and service ownership, review discipline, release quality, incident practices, and development of a senior engineering team.

The immediate challenge is to turn a broad, fast-moving product into a system with clear domain boundaries, independent review, reliable releases, and named primary and backup owners. You will work directly with the founder, customer leadership, and senior engineers.

What you will own

• Establish clear ownership for services, domains, releases, incidents, and critical customer workflows.
• Create an architecture and engineering-risk map for the multi-tenant platform.
• Build a review system where feature authors do not independently accept their own work.
• Improve PR cycle time, P0/P1 aging, release reliability, observability, and incident follow-through.
• Define standards for tenant isolation, migrations, billing and data integrity, APIs, integrations, testing, and production access.
• Hire, coach, and organize a small senior, AI-native engineering team.
• Use AI development tools productively while requiring independent evidence for generated output.
• Communicate tradeoffs clearly to product, customer, and business owners.

What we are looking for

• Engineering leadership in a production B2B SaaS company with complex operational workflows.
• Strong architectural depth in Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, APIs, and multi-tenant systems.
• Evidence of personally improving release quality, incident response, ownership, and engineering throughput.
• Experience leading senior engineers while remaining technically credible and hands-on when needed.
• Sound security and customer judgment, especially around production access and data integrity.
• Clear written communication in a distributed environment.
• Comfort working in an early-stage company where facts may be incomplete and risks must be made explicit.

Experience with GCP, payments, communications or voice systems, mobile field workflows, workflow automation, or vertical SaaS is useful but not required in every area.

First 90 days

You will produce an accepted architecture and ownership map, establish primary and backup owners for critical systems, implement independent PR, release, and incident gates, and demonstrate measurable movement in the first engineering reliability metrics.

Hiring process

The process includes an initial conversation, a deep functional interview, a paid bounded work sample using synthetic or redacted context, a cross-functional panel, and substantive reference checks. We evaluate ownership, professional depth, quality and risk judgment, customer understanding, remote communication, and responsible use of AI tools.

Exoserva evaluates candidates based on role-related evidence and does not discriminate on any basis protected by applicable law. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the hiring process, let us know through the LinkedIn application.

added.description:
Job Description

Job Title: VP, Information Technology

Location: Paramus, NJ

Job Type: Full Time/On-site 5 days/wk.

Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Information Systems, Computer Science, MIS, Engineering, or related technical discipline

Salary: $185,000 - $225,000

Job Summary

The Vice President of Information Technology provides strategic leadership for enterprise technology infrastructure and IT operations, overseeing networks, cloud platforms, data centers, end-user computing, telecommunications, and IT support services. This role drives technology modernization, security, resiliency, scalability, and service excellence while leading infrastructure strategy, cloud transformation, disaster recovery, and technology lifecycle management. As a key member of the leadership team, the VP advances innovation, operational resilience, and enterprise-wide technology initiatives.

Essential Functions

Serves as an integral member of the leadership team to promote the mission and demonstrate the values and ethics of the company
Leads the strategy, architecture, and operation of enterprise infrastructure, including networks, cloud platforms, hosted systems, servers, storage, and end-user computing, while establishing standard, governance, and lifecycle management practices that ensure scalable, reliable, and cost-effective operations
Oversees IT Service Desk operations to ensure high-quality, responsive, and consistent support for administrative and business users
Directs enterprise telecommunications and unified communications infrastructure, including voice, data, wireless, and collaboration platforms
Leads infrastructure modernization initiatives focused on automation, standardization, and improved enterprise service delivery
Monitors and improves IT operational performance through service level management, KPIs, and continuous improvement practices
Provides cybersecurity leadership to ensure infrastructure security, risk mitigation, and compliance with regulatory and banking requirements
Leads vendor management for infrastructure, cloud, telecom, and service providers, ensuring performance, accountability, and cost-effectiveness
Oversees capacity planning, infrastructure budgeting, and capital investment strategy to support current and future organizational needs
Provides executive leadership and mentoring to infrastructure, telecom, and service desk teams, building a strong culture of accountability, collaboration, and service excellence
Leads disaster recovery, business continuity, and major incident management programs to ensure operational resilience, clear communication, and rapid restoration of critical services.

Qualifications/Requirements

Demonstrated experience leading enterprise technology transformation initiatives, including cloud migration strategies, hybrid infrastructure environments, data center modernization, operational resiliency, and infrastructure standardization
Project Management Professional (PMP), ITIL, cloud, or related technical certifications are preferred
Proven leadership experience managing complex enterprise infrastructure environments including networking, telecommunications, cloud services, data centers, end-user computing, managed services, operational support, and business continuity programs.
Strong understanding of technology operations, Intelligent Transportation Systems, cybersecurity principles, and regulatory/compliance requirements
Experience developing and implementing enterprise architecture standards, operational governance models, lifecycle management strategies, and service delivery improvement initiatives
Strong knowledge of modern infrastructure technologies and platforms, including cloud services, enterprise networking, virtualization, identity management, infrastructure automation, and unified communications technologies
Experience overseeing strategic vendor relationships, managing service providers, technology contracts, and infrastructure-related budgeting and capital planning activities
Exceptional communication, organizational, analytical, and executive leadership skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across operational and executive leadership teams
Demonstrated ability to manage operational issues, lead during critical incidents, and balance strategic transformation initiatives with day-to-day operational excellence

Experience

Ten (10) years of progressive experience in enterprise infrastructure, technology operations, and IT engineering, including at least three (3) years in a senior leadership role overseeing infrastructure environments

added.title: Senior Director, Analytics Engineering, Data Analytics & AI
added.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential with Data & AI. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We're hiring for a Senior Director of Analytics Engineering to join our Data, Analytics, and AI organization (DAA), reporting directly to the Chief Data & Analytics Officer. You will lead a team of 20+ Analytics Engineers that build and operate the pipelines behind Snowflake's revenue, bookings, people analytics, and go-to-market reporting within our governed data platform.

This role has an in-office requirement — you must be able to work out of our Menlo Park office a minimum of 3 days a week.

In This Role You Will

Lead and grow the Analytics Engineering organization: Manage through your direct reports (team leads/managers), setting priorities and technical strategy across the team.
Drive Snowflake’s internal data transformation: Lead your teams' ongoing work to create an AI ready data foundation, with an emphasis on documentation, contracts, context, and governance.
Own Snowflake’s internal analytics agents: Build, improve, and maintain general purpose analytics agents - and underlying context and semantic layers - that can be used across the organization including evals, orchestration instructions, and ground truth data sets
Champion AI-assisted engineering: Drive adoption of Cortex Code-based agentic workflows and reusable skills across your teams to speed up typical Analytics Engineering jobs-to-be-done, including model development, PR review, and root-cause analysis.
Act as Snowflake’s customer zero: Be the first trusted tester of Snowflake’s own features across the data engineering and transformation stack, deeply engaging with Product and Engineering teams on product and feature roadmaps
Represent Snowflake: Support our GTM and Frontier Engineering teams by joining customer conversations, supporting speaking engagements, and publishing thought leadership, ultimately demonstrating the art of possible on Snowflake to all our customers and prospects
Continually push our stack forward: Push the boundaries of what we can accomplish on Snowflake, adopting the latest internal Data and AI capabilities.
Partner cross-functionally: Serve as the primary point of escalation for business stakeholders, driving towards a common roadmap and transforming upstream processes and workflows with data in mind
Represent your teams upward and cross-org: Contribute your teams' patterns and learnings to the Data, Analytics, and AI org's broader technical initiatives

What You Will Need

10+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or data architecture, including second line leadership experience managing managers or senior individual contributors across multiple teams.
A systems thinker at your core: You naturally see how individual data models, pipelines, and architectural decisions connect — and you design for second-order effects, not just the immediate problem.
Deep expertise in Snowflake, including data modeling, data governance (e.g., RBAC design, row access policies and masking policies), and the broader Snowflake feature set (Dynamic Tables, Streams, Tasks, Horizon, Cortex)
Expert-level dbt skills, including macro development, testing and CI/CD frameworks, and large-scale multi-team project management.
Hands-on experience with Airflow or similar orchestration platforms
A track record owning finance- or revenue-critical, deadline-driven data pipelines where accuracy and auditability are non-negotiable.
Familiarity with GTM and sales analytics domains: master data management, consumption & attainment pipelines, quota/territory data.
Advanced adoption of AI-assisted engineering tools — Cortex Code, Claude Code, or similar agent frameworks — including agentic skill development and prompt engineering for data workflows.
A record of driving large scale data transformation initiatives across complex organizations
Experience with downstream BI/consumption layers such as Streamlit, Sigma, Tableau, etc.
Comfort working in a Jira/Confluence-based agile delivery model.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of writing clear technical specs and stakeholder-facing materials for non-technical audiences

Every Snowflake employee is expected to follow the company’s confidentiality and security standards for handling sensitive data. Snowflake employees must abide by the company’s data security plan as an essential part of their duties. It is every employee's duty to keep customer information secure and confidential.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

The estimated base salary range for this role is $292,000 - $383,200.
Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending & health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

added.title: Software Engineering & Development, VP
added.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a experienced Dev
Lead and Architect
with 20+ years of enterprise IT experience
to provide technical leadership across enterprise applications, data platforms, analytics, reporting, and cloud-native solutions
.

This role is responsible for end‑to‑end architecture ownership
, guiding solution design from backend services through data engineering, analytics, reporting, and UI integration. The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in Java and Spring‑based enterprise systems
, Databricks and Python data platforms
, Oracle databases
, rule engines
, BI tools (Power BI, Tableau)
, and modern UI awareness (React)
, while leading and mentoring globally distributed development and QA teams
.

This position requires a balance of hands‑on technical depth, architectural judgment, and leadership
, with accountability for platform scalability, performance, governance, and long‑term sustainability.

Key Responsibilities

Define and govern data and analytics architecture using Databricks, Python, Spark, SQL, and Oracle databases, supporting large‑scale batch and real‑time processing.
Lead architecture and design of Java/J2EE and Spring‑based backend systems (Spring Core, Spring MVC, Spring Boot), including APIs, integration services, and complex enterprise workflows.
Architect and guide implementation of rule engines, business logic frameworks, and data validation/optimization strategies.
Drive performance tuning, data modeling, and optimization across databases, lakehouse platforms, and analytics workloads.
Provide architectural oversight for BI and reporting platforms such as Power BI and Tableau, enabling trusted and well‑governed datasets for analytics, regulatory, and executive reporting.
Ensure strong alignment between backend services, data platforms, analytics layers, and reporting tools, delivering consistent and reliable metrics.
Collaborate with application teams to ensure seamless integration between backend services, data platforms, and React‑based front‑end applications, including guidance on API and data access patterns.
Establish and maintain architecture standards, reference designs, and technical blueprints aligned with enterprise security, risk, and governance requirements.
Lead and mentor globally distributed development and QA teams, bringing Dev and QA together through shared architecture standards, delivery practices, and quality controls.
Act as a technical authority and mentor, conducting design reviews, providing technical guidance, and raising engineering and architectural maturity.
Partner with Product Managers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders to translate complex business requirements into robust, scalable, and maintainable solutions.
Provide senior technical leadership during production issues, including root‑cause analysis, remediation, and preventive improvements.
Advise senior technology leadership on platform modernization, architecture roadmaps, and strategic technology decisions.

Required Experience & Skills

15+ years of overall IT experience, including senior architecture and technical leadership roles.
Experience in Java, J2EE, Spring Core, Spring MVC, Spring Boot, and enterprise backend systems.
Proven experience designing and governing data platforms using Databricks, Python, Spark, and SQL.
Strong background in data optimization, performance tuning, and scalable system design.
Experience implementing and supporting rule engines and complex business logic frameworks.
Working knowledge of Power BI and Tableau, modern UI technologies, including React, and integration with backend and data platforms.
Exposure to AWS cloud services, cloud-native architecture, and hybrid/on‑prem to cloud migration.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Agile/Scrum delivery models.
Proven ability to lead and mentor global, cross‑functional teams.

Education & Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Experience in financial services or regulated enterprise environments preferred.
Cloud or data platform certifications (Databricks, AWS, etc.) are a plus.
Ability to work independently with high ownership while collaborating closely with leadership and business teams.

Salary Range

$120,000 - $217,500 Annual

The range quoted above applies to the role in the primary location specified. If the candidate would ultimately work outside of the primary location above, the applicable range could differ.
